definition.name: Fresh pure and joined BCL filesystem with authenticated native products

steps.name: Check closed filesystem derivation and argument controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_closed_filesystem tools.tests.test_sdk_scratch_probe -v

steps.name: Check pure joined source and strict actual outcome controls
Retrieve only exact source-bound native products and companion packages
Install captured NativeAOT namespace and loader inputs
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the pinned native compiler and closed runtime
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Build two fresh NativeAOT components and require all78 filesystem outcomes
Retain bounded source, compiler, component and node evidence
